input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a risk associated with A natural language processing system is designed to analyze text and provide sentiment analyses, aiming to understand the emotional tone and opinions expressed within the content. The system seeks to identify and interpret various forms of language, including those that may be discriminatory or hateful. Its purpose is to provide insights into the sentiment and emotional undertones of written text.
